findings.message: No icon found in the plugin. The validator looked for `icon` in plugin.json and for a file at .claude-plugin/icon.png or .svg, assets/icon.png or .svg, or a similar path.
findings.fix: Add a square PNG to the plugin folder at .claude-plugin/icon.png, or set `icon` in plugin.json to the path of a square PNG or JPEG in the plugin: 512 to 2048 px on each side, under 2 MB. SVG and WebP are not accepted. That file may become the listing icon only once: the first time the plugin is saved or submitted in the developer portal. Adding or changing it later does not change the icon.

notes: This folder also holds a marketplace manifest. The plugin directory treats such a folder as a plugin, so these checks cover only the plugin in this folder. To check another plugin that the marketplace lists, run validate on that plugin's folder.

skills.name: grey-matter:adopt-project
skills.description: Bring the grey-matter workflow into a repo that already has code and history: characterize the as-is model from the code, reconcile around what exists, seed a triaged board, and wire the plumbing — ending in a fully adopted repo. Use to adopt/onboard an existing (brownfield) project. Trigger: adopt this project, onboard existing repo, bring grey-matter into this codebase, brownfield adoption.

skills.name: grey-matter:changelog
skills.description: Maintain CHANGELOG.md in Keep a Changelog format with user-facing entries. Use when recording what changed for a release, updating the Unreleased section, or asked to write/update the changelog.

skills.name: grey-matter:cheat-sheet
skills.description: List every skill in this set by category with a one-line description. Use when the user wants a quick reference card of available skills, asks "what skills are there", or "list all commands".

skills.name: grey-matter:code-review
skills.description: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes: Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and files findings as tickets. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".

skills.name: grey-matter:codebase-design
skills.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.

skills.name: grey-matter:compass
skills.description: Find which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo. Use when you (or the agent) are unsure which skill to reach for, want to see how the skills fit together, or ask "what should I use for X".

skills.name: grey-matter:conformance-audit
skills.description: Audit a repo's skills, tool scripts, agent guidance, and docs against grey-matter's current standards, then apply the mechanically-safe fixes behind an approval gate. Use to re-conform an adopted repo as guidance evolves, or as a step inside adopt-project. Trigger: conformance audit, check repo against standards, re-conform, does this repo still follow current conventions.

skills.name: grey-matter:curate-docs
skills.description: Review docs/agents and .scratch for promotion and deletion: graduate mature notes into skills, move reference docs into a skill's references, and prune stale or superseded material.

skills.name: grey-matter:delivery-dashboard
skills.description: Maintain one evolving HTML dashboard showing what delivered work lets people do. Use when updating a delivery dashboard, showing shipped versus planned experiences, or presenting progress visually after work worth surfacing.

skills.name: grey-matter:diagnosing-bugs
skills.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.
